run_lightplane_renderer_naive: run the naive lightplane renderer to render rays against a 3D grid and return color and depth
run_lightplane_eval_mlp: run the MLP evaluation on sampled grid features to compute opacity and color for 3D points
run_lightplane_eval_mlp_opacity_only: run the opacity-only MLP evaluation on sampled grid features to compute opacity values for 3D points
run_sample_grid_list_checkpointed: run grid sampling from a list of 3D grids at given 3D points with optional gradient checkpointing
run_eval_mlp: run a multi-layer perceptron forward pass on input vectors using provided weights and biases
